verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence about an official Terraform or OpenTofu provider: nothing on who maintains it, how often it is released, or which services it covers. The only Terraform mention is Infrastructure Manager, a managed service for running Terraform deployments. That is an adjacent feature and does not show the provider itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run
